ranking: Descending minimum within-budget percentile, then mean percentile.
metric: Hungarian-matched mean IoU against CLARA ground-truth motion clusters, independently for K=4,8,16,32,64,128,256. Ground truth uses recorded material motion over 33 states, with endpoint motion above 1 mm. Static pixels count as false positives, unknown pixels are ignored; background cannot match a moving cluster.
cohort: Both external cameras at one informative recorded query per eligible successful K4 policy rollout. Eligible queries have a full 32-step future and at least 1 cm of observed object and robot motion; the query maximizing the smaller of those two motions is used. Views with fewer than 256 moving pixels or rendered/archived RGB mean absolute error of at least 10/255 are excluded. Every ground-truth cluster must be populated at all seven budgets.
selectorOutputs: Recomputed on native 128px renders of recorded policy states, at the original 16-step planning times. Changing K changes selector outputs on the same successful K4 rollout; it does not change the recorded actions.
playback: Native 2048px renders at every recorded prediction step, 16 actions apart. No new actions or trajectory forecasts.
imageEncoding: Native 2048x2048 JPEG, quality 90, no chroma subsampling; source JPEG quality 95 retained outside the website.
